items.title: Gamer Gets Hate for Playing GTA 6 While Their Wife is Giving Birth
items.summary: A viral TikTok of a new dad playing GTA 6 in the delivery room drew heavy backlash, though he says his wife suggested he bring the console.

items.title: 5 ways to make sure your console isn't holding back your GTA 6 performance
items.summary: Engadget notes that update 01.002.002 doesn't mention performance and that rumors of a Nov 25 stuttering fix came to nothing, then lists console tweaks.

items.title: Black Friday GTA 6 deals LIVE
items.summary: A live tracker of Black Friday GTA 6 discounts, including the first $10 price cut on the PS5 digital version in the US and cheaper Xbox and PS5 copies in the UK.

items.title: GTA 6 sales estimates place it above Cyberpunk 2077, The Sims, and the first Pokemon games as the 13th best-selling game ever
items.summary: Alinea Analytics estimates GTA 6 sold 53 million copies and made $4.7 billion in its first week, with about 76% of sales on PS5.

items.title: GTA 6 President's Bunker questline walkthrough: All Locations, Codes, Puzzles and Rewards
items.summary: A guide to the hidden President's Bunker questline, covering the codes, puzzles and the secret tank reward.

items.title: GTA 6 multiplayer reportedly running on PC as unofficial ports near completion, but it's certainly no Grand Theft Auto Online
items.summary: PortWatch says TeK's group has a private unofficial PC build with players, cars and proximity voice chat running at 25 to 30 fps, and mods are also reportedly appearing.

items.title: Former Rockstar artist says GTA 6 looks "almost flawless" but loses to Red Dead Redemption 2 in a few areas
items.summary: Ex-Rockstar environment artist David O'Reilly explored Mount Kalaga and said GTA 6's rivers and wilderness detail are slightly behind RDR2's, while its urban detail is stronger.

items.title: December 11 is Suddenly an Exciting Day for GTA 6 Players
items.summary: Rockstar will release the GTA 6 Original Score by Justice on December 11, on CD, vinyl and streaming.

items.title: GTA 6 Cut Features Officially Revealed by Rockstar
items.summary: Rockstar developers told PCGames.de that tennis, prone, house furnishing, item crafting and cinema visits were cut from the final game.

items.title: GTA 6 Secret Mission in Capri: How to Find and Complete the Hidden Mission
items.summary: A walkthrough of a hidden Capri mission that starts when you surrender to police and ends with the CPD Moreland 850 shotgun.
